title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visually Grounded Web Tasks
abstract: VisualWebArena is a benchmark suite for evaluating multimodal agents on realistic visually grounded web tasks. It comprises 910 tasks across three diverse web environments: Classifieds, Shopping, and Reddit. The benchmark suite assesses the visual and textual capabilities of autonomous agents, with a focus on integrating visual understanding with language processing.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're shopping online and want to buy a green polo shirt. You can't just type 'green polo shirt' into the search bar, because the website might not have that exact phrase. You need to look at the pictures and descriptions to find the right shirt. That's what multimodal agents do - they use both visual and textual information to accomplish tasks.

VisualWebArena is a benchmark suite that tests these agents on realistic web tasks, like buying a product or navigating to a specific page.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
VisualWebArena uses a partially observable Markov decision process to model the environment and agent. The agent receives observations, takes actions, and gets rewards based on its performance. The observation space includes webpage URLs, opened tabs, and webpage content.

The agent can take actions like clicking, typing, or navigating to a new page.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We evaluated state-of-the-art LLM and VLM agents on VisualWebArena. The best VLM agent achieved a success rate of 16.4%, while human performance was at 88.7%.

The results show that VLMs outperform text-based LLMs, but there's still a significant gap between agent and human performance.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
VisualWebArena fills a gap in the evaluation of multimodal agents. By testing agents on realistic web tasks, we can develop more effective agents that can assist humans in their daily lives.

The benchmark suite also provides insights into the limitations of current agents and the challenges of integrating visual and textual information.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
VisualWebArena introduces a new Set-of-Marks representation for visual elements on webpages. This allows agents to focus on high-level reasoning rather than low-level control.

The benchmark suite also includes a diverse set of tasks that require visual understanding, such as navigating to a specific page or selecting a product.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
You can try VisualWebArena yourself by running the benchmark suite on your own agents.

The code and tasks are available online, and you can evaluate your agents on the realistic web tasks.
